authored_metadata.use_guidance: Use this neutral MyST scaffold as a starting structure. Adapt headings and prose to the selected survey contract and evidence; do not treat placeholder text as a topic claim.

Use this neutral ACM acmart two-column conference presentation as the default LaTeX stock. Marker composition replaces % ISOMER_BODY with the converted MyST body; fill the title, authors, abstract, and keywords from the MyST frontmatter and fill manifest before claiming build readiness. The nonacm option intentionally omits invented publication metadata.
